name: Leaping Blaze
game_text: <phase>Shadow</phase>: Spot 3 <culture>Dunland</culture> minions to shuffle your hand into your draw deck and draw 8 cards. The Free Peoples player may discard 3 cards from hand to prevent this.
flavor_text: “...they saw torches, countless points of fiery light upon the black fields behind, scattered like red flowers, or winding up from the lowlands....”
